name: Naitik Kumar Gupta
tagline: Building modern web, mobile, and DevOps experiences.
about: I am a developer who builds across the stack — from React frontends to Node.js backends, Android apps in Kotlin, and full deployment platforms. Recent work includes DEPLOX (a self-hosted Vercel-like deploy platform), a college attendance system with face recognition and geo-fencing, a WebAR restaurant menu, and an offline Android file viewer.
goals: I want to keep building products that solve real problems and ship them on my own infrastructure. Currently exploring opportunities in full-stack and mobile engineering.

projects.title: DEPLOX
projects.description: Self-hosted deploy platform — push a GitHub repo and get a live URL. Detects the framework, builds it in an isolated container, and serves it on a per-deployment URL with auto-TLS.

projects.title: GLBITM Attendance System
projects.description: Production-ready college attendance system with rotating-QR anti-proxy self-marking, geo-fencing, face recognition, parent portal, and 2FA. 45+ features across web and mobile.

projects.title: VelvetBrew Coffee
projects.description: Full-stack coffee shop web app — animated landing, live menu API, pickup orders and table reservations, plus a real-time staff Kitchen Display System.

projects.title: OmniView
projects.description: 100% offline, ad-free Android app to view any file type: PDF, DOCX/XLSX/PPTX, images, video/audio, and 15+ code languages with syntax highlighting.

projects.title: Event Checkin
projects.description: Lightweight event check-in platform — guests register online, get a unique QR pass, and hosts scan codes on the door. Live attendance dashboard, capacity tracking, and CSV export for organizers.

projects.title: Screen Recorder Android
projects.description: Modern Android screen recorder built with Jetpack Compose and MediaProjection API — floating overlay controls, on-screen drawing pen, internal/mic audio capture, direct gallery export.

education.college: GL Bajaj Institute of Technology and Management
education.description: Studying computer science with focus on full-stack development, mobile apps, and DevOps. Built the college's production attendance system as a hands-on project.
